facts.text: Holy Cross College forms a tri-campus partnership with Notre Dame and Saint Mary's College, enabling students to take one course per semester at either partner institution and join shared clubs.

sources.title: Tri-Campus & South Bend Area - Holy Cross
sources.quote: The University of Notre Dame, Saint Mary's College, and Holy Cross College share a common history, mission, and even the same post office! Together, we form a tri-campus in which many amazing resources—clubs, classes, sporting events, a student newspaper—are shared.

sources.title: Tri-Campus & South Bend Area - Holy Cross
sources.quote: Take 1 course per semester at Notre Dame or Saint Mary's. *More info in the Academic Catalog.
